question: What is the nature of the practice and creation established here?
premises: The same transcendent practice appears here with the state of difference swallowed.
This is the full great creation of the supreme Lord.
inference: The practice established here is nondual, and it is identical with the supreme Lord's full great creation.
plain_english: That same practice here would be one in which the state of difference is swallowed; this is the full great creation of the supreme Lord, established here.
